findings.title: Boot-window HELM downgrade at the systemEntryStyle player-entry sites
findings.mechanism: The four player-intent entry gates (nav dispatch 'normal' branch, commitSelection/Space, mobile double-tap, mobile WARP button) read raw _scManual, which is false for the whole boot window even on a HELM pick (consumed only at warpRevealSystem). A HELM booter who manually dismissed the title and entered a system during the 15s nebula linger (or after activity-cancel, indefinitely) resolved to 'orrery' → instant-cut → _enterSystemInstantOrrery's flag consume hardcoded _pendingBootMode='orrery' — the pick silently destroyed, no tour ever armed, unrecoverable without relaunch. The 8b35ec4 diff fixed this exact _scManual dishonesty at the title-end and linger gates but missed the entry sites.
findings.fix: _effectiveRegime() helper (pending boot reveal → bootModeAction(_pendingBootMode).mode, else _scManual read) shared by the four entry sites and the linger gate. Title-end gate untouched (definitionally pre-reveal). In-system interaction gates (Tab/body-click/burn/re-arm/autonav toggles) deliberately stay on raw _scManual — inert pre-reveal (no bodies, no tour), none consume boot flags, both lenses cleared them.
findings.uatStep: Boot HELM → key-dismiss the title → immediately enter a system (bg-star + Space, or N + pick + commit) → expect the CINEMATIC warp and the tour armed at YOUR target.

findings.mechanism: For binaries the primary sits at offset r1 from the barycenter, so the new star anchor shifts the Esc-overview pivot off the old origin/barycenter pivot — negligible for close pairs, visible for wide ones. 'Behavior-identical' held only for single-star systems.
